distanceNote: About 3.7 mi of mapped hiking: one South Jenny Lake leg and one west-dock leg, meeting at Inspiration Point. The optional Hidden Falls spur, boat crossing and parking/dock connectors are excluded. The west-dock land endpoint is about 49 m short of the NPS dock marker. This is a USGS corridor estimate, not a published NPS mixed-route total or a navigation track.

transportSource.note: NPS documents round-trip and one-way shuttle options in either direction, including walking one leg around the south shore.

comparison.summary: AllTrails shows the recognizable west-dock approach and Inspiration Point destination, while this option adds one south-shore walking leg and uses the boat only once.

options.name: Inspiration Point — Shuttle Out, Walk Back
options.label: Shuttle out, walk back
options.start: East Shore Boat Dock for the crossing; hike from West Shore Boat Dock
options.returnPlan: From Inspiration Point, walk back via the south lakeshore to Jenny Lake Trailhead. No return boat is needed.

options.name: Inspiration Point — Walk Out, Shuttle Back
options.label: Walk out, shuttle back
options.start: Jenny Lake Trailhead (south shore); walk via the south lakeshore to Inspiration Point
options.returnPlan: Descend to West Shore Boat Dock and take the boat to East Shore Boat Dock before the last return crossing.
